title: Y'all are on fire
description: U.S. Air Force Tech. Sgt. Christopher Parker, 48th Civil Engineer assistant chief, and Master Sgt. Cody Freel, 48th CES flight superintendent deputy fire chief, discuss daily operations in the fire department at RAF Lakenheath, England. Firefighters hold multiple training exercises such as structural burns, aircraft burns, chemicals and repelling to ensure mission readiness and base safety. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Alexander Vasquez)
keywords: Civil Engineer, Fire Department, Liberty Wing, 48FW, Fire
